_about: Notes for translators, by key. Messages are ICU MessageFormat: keep every {placeholder}, every and the plural/select structure; translate the text inside each branch and add the plural categories your language needs (Arabic: zero, one, two, few, many, other). {x, number} prints a number in your language's format; # prints the plural's number. Inside a sentence, … is a link, … bold, and are filled in by the app. Glossary, never-translate list and tone: LOCALIZATION.md.
seo.home.title: Browser tab and search result title of the home page. Under 60 characters if you can. Keep '| wxrks' at the end. The numbers in the descriptions (2,000 words, about 8 pages) are the free limit: write them in your language's number format.
seo.home.description: Search result description, under 160 characters if you can.
seo.home.heading: The page's main heading (h1), shown before and after the app loads.
seo.home.intro: One line under the heading, shown to search engines and while the app loads.
seo.pdf.title: Title of the PDF landing page. Under 60 characters if you can.
seo.documents.title: Title of the Word/PowerPoint/Excel landing page. '&' is fine here if your language uses it in titles; otherwise write 'and'.
nav.homeLabel: Screen-reader label of the logo link to the home page. 'wxrks Translate' is the product name and stays in English.
nav.myJobs: Header link to the list of the person's translations ('jobs'). Short: it shares the header with three other links.
common.buyWords: Button or link to the word packs (prices). 'Words' are what is bought: one credit translates one source word into one language. Short.
common.getCredits: Button. {amount} is a price, e.g. '$18'. 'Credits' are prepaid words (see glossary).
common.newHere: Banner for people without an account. {amount} is a price, e.g. '$18'.
common.emailPlaceholder: Example address inside the email field. Use your market's usual example (e.g. voce@empresa.com); keep it a valid-looking address.
common.pdfFiles: A checklist item: what a PDF comes back as.
creditAdded.text: Notice after a new account is made. {amount} is a price ('$18'); {balance} is a word count with pages, e.g. '20,000 words (about 80 pages)'. <strong> is the first sentence in bold.
suggest.text: Shown, in YOUR language, to visitors whose browser prefers your language while they read the English site. Name your own language: e.g. es 'Esta página también está disponible en español.'
suggest.accept: Button on that notice: switch the page to your language. Name your language: e.g. es 'Ver en español'.
suggest.dismiss: Always shown in English (the visitor is on the English page). Translate it anyway, for completeness.
suggest.label: Screen-reader name of that notice.
footer.credits: Footer. 'wxrks Translate' is the product name; AGPL-3.0 is a license name. <company> links to wxrks.com, <repo> to the source code.
footer.languages: Screen-reader name of the list of languages in the footer.
units.words: A word count, e.g. '12,000 words'. Used alone and inside other sentences.
units.aboutPages: An estimate in pages, e.g. 'about 40 pages' (250 words a page). Used after a word count in parentheses.
units.wordsAndPages: '10,000 words (about 40 pages)'. Inserted into many sentences as {amount}, {balance} or {creditAmount}: keep it a noun phrase.
units.packLabel: A word pack: '$9 for 10,000 words (about 40 pages)'. {price} is a formatted price; {amount} is units.wordsAndPages.
units.perThousand: Price per 1,000 words, e.g. '$0.90 per 1,000 words'.
errors.generic: Any error the app has no better message for.
errors.too_many_languages: {max} is the most languages one document can go into (3).
errors.file_too_large: {maxMb} is the upload limit in megabytes (25). Write the unit the way your language does (e.g. fr 'Mo').
errors.free_limit_reached: Guests get one free document a day.
upload.landing.home: Line under the home page heading.
upload.drop.title: Main line of the drop zone where people drop or pick a file.
upload.drop.hint: Under the drop zone. {size} is the size limit, already formatted ('25 MB').
upload.drop.hintSignedIn: {size} as above; {files} is the most files per job (10).
upload.file.remove: Button beside a picked file (signed-in people, several files): remove it from the list.
upload.file.change: Same button for guests, who send one file: pick another file instead.
upload.onlyFirstFile: <file/> is replaced by the name of the file that was kept. <a> links to sign in. {count} is 10.
upload.from: Label of the field for the document's own language.
upload.into: Label of the field for the languages to translate into.
upload.intoPlaceholder: Placeholder in that field. Name a language your readers often translate into, as an example.
upload.submit: The main button: upload the file and start translating. Short.
upload.moreLanguages: Shown when 3 languages are picked. {max} is 3. <a> links to wxrks's own site.
freeUsed.body: Two selects. {when}: 'hours' when we know how many hours until the next free document ({hours}), otherwise 'other' (tomorrow). {offer}: 'signup' offers the sign-up credit ({credit} a price, {creditAmount} words with pages), 'other' offers the smallest pack ({packAmount} words with pages, {price}). Write each branch as complete sentences.
platform.memory.label: A short pill naming a locked feature of the paid wxrks platform: translation memory. One or two words.
platform.history.label: Pill: the list of files translated before. One or two words.
platform.cta: Link to wxrks.com to start a free trial of the platform.
tone.preset.auto.label: One of six tone buttons for the translation. Short: they sit in one row.
tone.preset.formal.hint: About the translation's output language, not yours: the formal 'you' (vous, Sie, usted...) where that language has one.
tone.withNote: A tone with the visitor's own note in quotes. Use your language's quotation marks.
tone.pill: The tone button: 'Tone: Formal + note'. {label} is the tone's name; {note} is 'yes' when the visitor wrote a note.
tone.byline: Sous-Chef is the name of the wxrks tone agent and stays in English.
tone.notePlaceholder: Placeholder of the note field. Give an example of a note in your language.
trust.g2Alt: Alt text of the G2 badge image. 'G2 Leader' is the award's name; translate the season.
trust.about: 'SOC 2 Type 2' is an audit's name and stays as is.
picker.count: Next to the field label: '2 of 3' languages picked.
picker.full: Placeholder when 3 languages are picked: no more can be added.
picker.remove: Screen-reader label of the × on a picked language. {language} is its name.
progress.received.label: Steps of a translation in progress, each kept on screen once done. 'label' is the step done (past), 'active' while it runs, 'todo' before it starts, 'sub' a line under the page heading while it runs, 'detail' a small line under a done step.
progress.sample.picked: {range}: 'span' for several pages ({first} to {last}), 'single' for one page ({first}), 'other' before the pages are known. Write each branch as a whole phrase.
progress.sample.translated: {range} as above; {language} is a language's name, in your language, as it reads inside a sentence.
progress.translate.label: {language} is a language's name in your language, as it reads inside a sentence (lowercase where your language writes it so).
progress.earlier: Shown instead of a time beside a step that was done before (an earlier run of the same file).
progress.usuallyMinutes: How long the step usually takes. 'min' may be abbreviated.
progress.srDone: Read by screen readers after a done step's name.
job.fileCount: Instead of a file name when a job has several files.
job.cancel: Link that cancels the translation in progress.
job.toneBySousChef: {tone} is the tone's name (and the visitor's note). Sous-Chef stays in English.
job.stopped.noTextBody: {reason} is one of the job.noText messages (whole sentences).
job.delivered.tone: {tone} is the tone's name, maybe with the visitor's note.
job.delivered.useNow: Small uppercase label over the downloads. Short.
job.delivered.downloadLanguage: Button: one ZIP with every file of one language. {language} is the language's name, standing alone.
job.next.body: {account}: 'user' when signed in, 'other' for a guest. {amount} and {creditAmount} are word counts with pages; {credit} a price.
job.card.balance: {amount} is a word count with pages: what is left in the account.
job.progress.steps: Over the progress bar: '3 of 7 steps done'.
job.status.ready: A small status badge: the file is ready to be translated in full (it went over the free limit; don't say so, it reads as a refusal).
job.score.name: Confidence Score is a wxrks feature name and stays in English.
job.score.summary: Smells is the name of the wxrks quality check and stays in English. {sentences} is how many sentences it read; {flagged} how many it flagged.
job.score.part.clean: Legend of a bar chart: how many sentences have no problems, minor, major or critical ones. The noun understood is 'sentences'.
job.flagged.original: Before the original sentence of a flagged translation. <text/> is that sentence.
job.review.eyebrow: Small uppercase label over the reviewers card. Short.
job.review.title: {count} is how many sentences the check flagged (0, 1 or more).
job.review.intro: {partners}: 'yes' when partners are listed below. {language} is the target language, inside a sentence.
job.review.footer: 'Premium Partners' is the name of a wxrks marketplace program and stays in English. <a> links to the marketplace.
job.download.zip: {several}: 'yes' when the job has several languages.
job.sample.range: A page range of the free sample: 'Pages 3–9 of 252'. {span}: 'yes' for several pages; {hasTotal}: 'yes' when the file's page count is known.
job.sample.caption: Under the sample. {range} is job.sample.range; {hasTone}: 'yes' with {tone}, the tone's name.
job.sample.previous: Button to the previous page of the sample. The arrow is added by the app.
job.sample.next: Button to the next page. The arrow is added by the app.
job.over.notNow: Starts a line of small alternative links (shorter file, buy words, team account).
job.over.readyAll: Heading. {hasTotal}: 'yes' when the page count ({total}) is known.
job.over.uses: {languages} is a list of languages; {credits} what this file uses; {balance} what the account has; {rest} what stays (words with pages), {restWords} its number.
job.over.short: {fits}: 'yes' when a word pack ({pack}, e.g. '$9 for 10,000 words (about 40 pages)') covers the file.
job.over.typeEmail: The main heading of the offer card: type an email address and get the whole file. Marketing headline: keep it short and direct.
job.over.signupSub: {restPack}: 'yes' when the sign-up credit doesn't cover the file and a pack ({price}) covers the rest ({rest} words).
job.over.sampled: {alsoFree}: 'yes' when the remaining {left} pages are covered by the sign-up credit.
job.over.stickyNote: {toGo}: 'yes' when some pages ({left}) are still untranslated.
job.needs.body: {known}: 'yes' when the word count is known. {pages} is 'about N pages'; {amount} a word count with pages.
offer.emailLabel: Label of the email field on the offer card.
offer.stickyLabel: Screen-reader name of the offer that stays at the bottom of a phone screen.
packs.pages: An estimate in pages in parentheses under a pack's word count. {about} is units.aboutPages.
packs.byEmail: Shown only while online payment is off. <a> is the email address ({email}).
pricing.balance: <b> is in bold, <muted> in grey. {hasPages}: 'yes' when the balance is above 0, then {about} is 'about N pages'.
thanks.inAccount: Heading after a payment. {amount} is the words bought with pages; {words} its number.
login.sentCredit: {amount} is a price; {words} a word count with pages.
account.kind.charge: A row in the credit history: words used by a translation.
account.kind.grant: A row in the credit history: words the wxrks team added by hand.
jobs.languages: One row of the jobs list: the document's language, then the languages it went into. Point the arrow along your reading direction (Arabic: ←).
jobs.status.inProgress: Small status badges in the jobs list. Short.
activity.pill: A pill showing a real translation someone made this week: '783 words translated from Portuguese into English · earlier today'. {from} and {to} are language names inside a sentence ({to} may be a list). {when}: 'moments', 'minutes', 'today', or 'other' (no time shown).
